title: Conjugate CFD Study of Pulsed Dielectric-Fluid Flow for Thermal Management of an 18650 Battery Module at Equal Pump Energy: data and code
description:
Data and code for a conjugate CFD study of steady and pulsed dielectric-fluid flow in single-phase immersion cooling of a six-cell 18650 lithium-ion module (HFE-7200 in a closed housing, 3C discharge of 900 s), compared at matched pump energy: at the same mean flow a pulsed schedule always costs more pumping energy than steady flow, because <Q²> ≥ <Q>². Solver: OpenFOAM v2606 (ESI) chtMultiRegionFoam, laminar, variable properties, structured multi-block mesh.

Contents: the 14 scored cases (OpenFOAM setup files, every monitor series and a slim solver-log extract per case, as tar.xz archives), the results table, the per-case numerical checks, derived temperature histories, the Python scripts that regenerate the results table, the checks and the paper's figures from the case archives (scripts/reproduce.sh), and the generator modules that re-create each case's OpenFOAM setup (Allrun.pre). Field data, meshes and full solver logs are not included and are available from the authors on request.

Code (scripts/): MIT License. Data and documentation: CC BY 4.0 (see LICENSE and LICENSE-DATA).
